_comments: The job type that extends each active meeting series' occurrences up to the horizon (the meetings plan, § 3). Its driver, ScheduledJobMeetingSeriesMaterialization, registers from @mj-biz-apps/tasks-server. Optional Configuration: { "HorizonDays": <number> }, default 90.

fields.Name: Meeting Series Materialization
fields.Description: Extends each active meeting series' occurrences up to the horizon: a slot with no meeting gets one, an untouched future meeting takes the series' current values, and a series whose rule has run out is marked Ended. Optional Configuration: { "HorizonDays": <number> }, default 90.
